answer_1.quote: We validate our approach on multiple sequence generation tasks. For neural machine translation, we train our model from scratch. For other tasks, we first perform pre-training using our methods on BART-base to obtain BART-JANUS, then use the downstream task to finetune the BART-JANUS.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include machine-translated text, abstractive summaries, and dialog responses.

answer_2.quote: The raw texts are encoded using BPE as the subword units and report test set performance by measuring BLEU.
